verdict: The Hospital Hierarchy lands as the flagship MedKayfab deck — 56 roles, zero wasted cards, from Blade-the-Titan's god-complex to EMR-the-Digital-Slavery's data-prison. Vigil-the-Vanguard and Burn-the-Out-Shadow are two of the best cards in the entire Kayfabizarro corpus. The system-traps page is a masterstroke of educational satire that healthcare workers will print and tape to their lockers. Minor weak spot: the three quest cards on page 15 use a game mechanic that doesn't fit the standard card grammar — rule-text masquerading as lore with no power box. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: Fifty-six hospital archetypes as wrestling characters — from the God-Tier neurosurgeon to the EMR-enslaved resident. Perfect for medical education, team workshops, and every healthcare worker who's survived a night shift.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — Chaotic hospital nursing station with FrizzleBob rabbit, dragon CEO, elephant nurse, and armored bear surgeon. Every major archetype signaled at a glance.
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — 'MedKayfab Team Wrestling: The Hospital Hierarchy' + 'Know your team. Watch your back. Stay fluffy!' Perfect double-register.
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — 100% match: the cover's cast mirrors the deck's energy exactly. No gap between promise and delivery.
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — Strong and distinctive, consistent with MedKayfab series style. Not reinventing the formula but executing it at peak.
coverQA.coverViral: 5 — Healthcare workers will share this cover unprompted. Dragon CEO with 'Empathy: 0' stamp alone earns the 5.
coverQA.coverNote: Strongest MedKayfab cover in the series so far. The chaos at the nursing station is perfectly calibrated — not overwhelming, just right. 'Call Doc Frizzle!' stamp in the corner is a nice easter egg.

notes: 15 pages: 1 cover + 14 card pages. Standard 2x2 grid throughout. Page 14 explicitly labeled 'SYSTEM TRAPS' — 4 antagonist/systemic villain cards. Page 15 has 1 meta-synthesis card (The Hospital Attending) + 3 quest mechanic cards; these use no standard power box, embed mechanic in lore as 'QUEST RULE:'. No RAF dice boxes visible. Kayfabizarro: THE HOSPITAL HIERARCHY – The Chain of Command Nobody Wrote Down (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

The hospital runs on a pecking order nobody printed, and everybody on the ward can recite it from memory by week two.

Here is how the ladder actually works. The attending decides, the registrar translates the decision into orders, the resident carries the orders until the resident becomes one with the chart, and the night shift inherits whatever nobody upstairs wanted to sign off on. Rank flows downhill and so does blame, and the whole structure holds because each rung defers to the rung above it faster than it questions the patient in front of it. The opponent here is not the one arrogant surgeon you can name. It is the unwritten ladder itself, the reflex that treats a job title as a measure of how much a person's exhaustion is allowed to count.

The Hospital Hierarchy is Social Story Wrestling for the ward. Fifty-six archetypes you step into and perform out loud, from the God-Tier neurosurgeon who has never personally seen a bedpan to the resident slowly being digitized by the records system. You do not read a card about burnout and nod. You play the figure, work the room, and find out which rung of the ladder you instinctively reach for when the monitor starts screaming.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Hospital Hierarchy Core Deck: 56 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring Vigil-the-Vanguard (the one who has not slept since the handover and is running on spite and coffee), Burn-the-Out-Shadow (the colleague who is technically still here), and EMR-the-Digital-Slavery (the records system that turned a healer into a data-entry clerk).
- The Freestyle Rules: The complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and a table that decides out loud whether your bit earned the room.
- The System Traps: four antagonist cards that personify the things that break people instead of patients, capped by The Hospital Attending, the meta-synthesis figure every other card on the ward is secretly performing for.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
By grabbing this deck you are not buying a static PDF. You are joining the MedKayfab roster, and as the cast of the ward grows, new archetypes and topic expansions in this series land in your library as free updates. The hierarchy only gets deeper.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I am a physician and an artist. I made this for everyone who has survived a night shift and needed to laugh at the ladder before the ladder finished laughing at them. Broke, on a student stipend, or working in a place where five euros is real money? Enter "0" and take it. Want to support the craft? Every cent goes straight into drawing the next card.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"The org chart is just a story about who gets to be tired. Rewrite it."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
